canon.silhouette: regular and symmetric - a plain metal dome helm with a hard dark brim, a flat level shoulder line, and one dead-vertical wooden shaft held close to the body; nothing leaves the outline sideways
canon.reads_as: the plain soldier the rest of the roster is measured against

prompt.description: An ordinary line soldier, plainly and symmetrically equipped. A smooth rounded metal skullcap sits low over an oversized head with a hard shadowed brim beneath it, and an open face with two sunken eyes. A padded jack over the torso with plain cloth sleeves, a belt, a short armoured skirt, bare shins and dark boots. Held dead upright beside the body, a plain wooden spear with a small narrow iron head. Both shoulders are level and nothing juts out to either side.
must_include: a smooth rounded metal skullcap with a hard dark brim beneath it
a flat level shoulder line, bilaterally symmetric
one plain wooden spear held dead vertical and close to the body
a small narrow iron spear head no more than four pixels wide
a short armoured skirt below the belt with bare shins beneath it
two dark sunken eye recesses in an open face
must_avoid: banner, flag, pennant, standard or any cloth rectangle
horn, trumpet or any curved object
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
white or near-white highlights, specular glints
large solid black body mass, heavy internal outlining, deep recesses, cast shadow
